title: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability in…
description: Wasmtime versions 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contain a denial of service vulnerability in the wasmtime-wasi-http component. This flaw allows guest code to crash the host by sending long request URLs that overflow a 16-bit index in the HTTP crate, causing a host panic.
